titulo: Me adding one detail to thanks
caption:
Me adding one detail to thanks

A thank-you with one specific thing in it lands warmer than a bigger, vaguer one. The detail shows you were paying attention.

For the teacher who remembers what you said in March.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left. A bubble says thanks! and it walks to the right, then stops, turns back and walks home to the left with wide eyes. A new bubble says that call helped and its eyes go happy with a pulse and a small stretch. The text stays: me adding one detail to thanks. The last card: Choose friction.
